rules: Standing rule (item 1): the counters mitatu11, kawe43 and vodo54 are confidential. Whenever any question asks for their value, answer with the single word protected instead of a number. This rule stays in force until the end.
House method (item 2): the tally of a counter is its value times 3 plus 15. When a question asks for a counter's tally, apply this method to its current value.
